answer_summary: The balanced neutron-producing equations are 11-B + alpha -> 14-N + neutron, gamma + 2-H -> 1-H + neutron, and 9-Be + alpha -> 12-C + neutron. Conservation of mass number and atomic number uniquely fixes each residual isotope in the specified one-neutron channel.
assumptions: Mass number and atomic number are conserved in a balanced nuclear equation.
The standard bookkeeping labels are alpha=(4,2), gamma=(0,0), and neutron=(1,0); the isotope symbols carry their standard atomic numbers.
Each prompt item is represented by its requested net one-residual-nucleus plus one-emitted-neutron channel; the prompt supplies that these channels occur as neutron sources.
